name: finding_id
description: Id of the finding, also the name of its detail file

name: subject_id
description: Id of the facility or cluster

name: kind
description: facility, or cluster when the reported total sums several facilities

name: name
description: Name as the register gives it

name: operator
description: Operator, where the register gives one

name: sector
description: Sector, as the register gives it

name: country
description: Two-letter country code

name: city
description: City or town, where known

name: lat
description: Latitude of the site, degrees

name: lon
description: Longitude of the site, degrees

name: register
description: Where the reported figure comes from

name: register_id
description: Id in that register

name: period
description: Calendar year the finding covers

name: reported_t
description: Reported NOx in tonnes a year, as NO2 mass

name: reported_basis
description: How the reported value was obtained: measured, calculated, estimated, stated

name: estimate_t
description: Satellite-based estimate of NOx in tonnes a year, as NO2 mass

name: estimate_lo
description: Lower end of the 95% interval

name: estimate_hi
description: Upper end of the 95% interval

name: interval_basis
description: sampling when the interval covers sampling noise only

name: n_days
description: Clear, windy days used

name: lifetime_h
description: Fitted NO2 lifetime in the plume, hours

name: ratio
description: Estimate divided by reported. Empty for sources with no verdict

name: ratio_lo
description: Lower end of the ratio's 95% interval, with the systematic uncertainty

name: ratio_hi
description: Upper end of the ratio's 95% interval, with the systematic uncertainty

name: verdict
description: higher, consistent, lower or inconclusive. Empty when not compared

name: grade
description: A, B or C. Empty when there is no verdict

name: us_test_site
description: True for the US power plants used to test the method

name: below_reliable_detection
description: True when the footprint is under the size the method measures reliably

name: cluster_facilities
description: Number of facilities in the reported total, for clusters
